{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Phantom''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health and decent speed. As it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, towers need hidden detection to target it. ==Logbook Description== "''Phantoms exist as those who died within the Void. Typically, one would have to turn and accept the Void’s whispers and peacefully lay their head in the flora after the shock of losing their realm subsides and dread sets in. There are some who resent and fight the Void, but others who chose to be cradled by it. Those who surrender themselves are then turned into Phantoms and are either returned to their bodies, becoming an Odd, or stay as a spirit. When a Phantom is around, the Void Energy within them acts like a black hole by drawing in anything that’s around them. It’s not powerful, but many Odds unfortunately wander into one and are subsequently crushed to the size of a baseball.''" ==Appearance== The '''Phantom''' is a purple ghost with a translucent body. In place of legs it has a tail. It wears a purple shirt and hood. It floats above the path. ==Strategy== *As the '''Phantom''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears early on, cheap towers with hidden detection like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Operator]], [[Saboteur]] and various other towers can be used to handle it with ease. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} PhantomCA.png|'''Phantom''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernPhantomIconIG.png|'''Phantom''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Phantom''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Phantom''' added, replacing the [[Invisible]]. {{Hardcore|[[Mandrake]]|Wave 8|Phantom|Wave 10|[[Balloon]]|Wave 12}} {{Voidcore|[[Cursed Skeleton]]|Wave 8|Phantom|Wave 10|[[Balloon]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
